name: Alice Erzan
source:
The only daughter of a nobleman who's been the commander of the Chivalric order for generations.

She's served as leader of the order from a young age, carefully raised to be a prim and proper daughter. Alice is both pure and innocent, shy, and easily embarrassed. A strong sense of justice, her mission is to protect the people of the city.

She knows absolutely nothing about sex.

When she saw Tomohiro's male genitalia for the first time, she nearly fainted. Yet as his wife she is wholly devoted to him.

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/3ping/char.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
